memo:
EdgeHound Supervisory Review — 27 June 2026

Portfolio is down 14.05% from inception (equity $8,595 vs $10,000 start), with realized losses of -$1,538 across 259 closed trades. The headline concern remains MOMENTUM (-$1,019, 8W/21T, 38% win rate) and SMART_CONSENSUS (-$385, 0W/1T), both correctly disabled in the prior session. The active engine mix is now SHORT_FAVORITE, VOLUME_SPIKE, and ELITE_FOLLOW.

The core SHORT_FAVORITE thesis on sports markets remains the portfolio's only validated edge: 117W/50L at 70% win rate (90% CI 64-76%), statistically robust at n=167. The non-sports SHORT_FAVORITE cohort sits at 50% with wide CIs (n=22) — no edge confirmed, but also not yet condemned. VOLUME_SPIKE shows modest positive PnL (+$190) and ELITE_FOLLOW is marginally positive (+$106), both with insufficient settled trades to draw strong conclusions.

A structural concern: stop-loss events on SHORT_FAVORITE are generating outsized losses when they occur. In the recent log, Athletics/SF Giants lost -$95 on a $100 stake, and Philadelphia Phillies lost -$80, suggesting some bets at very high entry prices (0.88-0.91) are experiencing catastrophic reversals. These are not small edge erosions — they are tail events. The bot should be cautious entering SHORT_FAVORITE positions above 0.90 entry price, as the asymmetric loss profile at those levels is severe.

No parameter changes warranted at this time. KellyMult at 0.13 is appropriately conservative. Current configuration is defensible pending more settled data on VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW.

changeReasoning: No changes warranted this session. The validated edge in SHORT_FAVORITE sports markets is intact and the conservative sizing (kellyMult 0.13) is appropriate given the -14% drawdown and the presence of tail-loss events on high-entry-price bets. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW need more settled trades before any sizing adjustment is justified. Disabling additional engines would over-concentrate the book into SHORT_FAVORITE only, removing diversification from the two modestly positive signals. Raising pMin above 0.60 could filter out the validated sports edge if it inadvertently excludes entries in the 0.60-0.68 zone where the hypothesis operates. Patience is the correct posture here.

Portfolio down 14% from inception; further significant drawdown could impair the bot's ability to recover meaningfully with small kelly fractions
Non-sports SHORT_FAVORITE (soccer O/U, draw markets) showing 50% win rate at n=22 — if this cohort continues without edge confirmation it should be selectively filtered from the engine
